comment: Fork's promoted evaluators for the page (DESIGN.md §5.5), oldest first. Every value below is copied from docs/nets.md and docs/history/phase-4/sprt-log.md (2026-11-02); the build (.github/workflows/web.yml) adds each module's file, size and SHA-256. scale is the output scale S the evaluation bar reads scores with (docs/nets.md); the bootstrap evaluation has none of its own, so it takes 134, the S with which B0's training read the bootstrap's labels (docs/nets.md, B0). Each validation loss is on its own data's held-out games, so losses on different data are not comparable.
